title: Floral Warfare
description: Adds items, mobs, blocks and more from Plants vs. Zombies. (W.I.P).
body:
![FloralWarfare Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d3da0126580c0f21f6594781b3bbf39e925bbd4b.png)
_The Zombies.. are coming..._\
**Floral Warfare** is a Plants vs Zombies inspired mod that brings items, blocks, mobs and structures to minecraft.

# THIS MOD IS STILL IN DEVELOPMENT.

## Progression
- Progression is currently still work in progress, so for now plants are found in these structures
  - ancient city
  - bastion
  - buried treasure
  - desert pyramid
  - igloo
  - jungle temple
  - ruined portal
  - shipwreck
  - simple dungeons
  - woodland mansion

### Current Featues
- Growing plants.
  - To grow a plant, you'll need to plant Sprouts, which have 3 growth stages
  - Each growth stage last for 1 minute 
  - Once the sprout reaches a growth stage (will show with particles), it require the following to progress.
    - Stage 1: needs to be watered by a Watering Can (Currently unobtainable)
    - Stage 2: needs to be bonemealed
    - Stage 3: needs to be fed with fertilizer.
  - After stage 3 it will grow in a random plant (customizable with tags)
    - Normal Sprout `normal_sprout_pool`
    - Pea Sprout `pea_sprout_pool`
    - ShroomSprout `shroom_sprout_pool`
- Plant Wellbeing /// This feature is w.i.p, if you have suggestions please send it in a github issue ///
  - Personality
    - All plants spawn with the `Null` personality by default.
    - When the plant is tamed, it will generate a new random personality.
      - Though some plants will have a higher chance of getting a beneficial personality.
    - Personality currently only affects morale gain/loss
  - Morale
    - Morale currently only affects the plant's stat, such as.
      - Attack damage (capped at 2)
      - Damage resistance (capped at 2)
    - Morale also affects the plant's appearance (currently only visible on Sunflower)
- Plant Experience /// W.I.P ///
  - As the plant performs an action, it eventually gets better at it.
  - For example, Peashooters shoot 25%, Sun Producers having a chance to produce double sun, etc...
  - Though for some plants like Repeater, it needs experience to become a Gatling Pea.
